summary: Black Titan Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated August 14, 2026, providing a research and market commentary note on structural developments in the Lending-as-a-Service (LaaS) and DeFi-as-a-Service (DaaS) infrastructure ecosystem. The commentary discusses integrations by Uniswap, Bitget, HashKey, and Base, but does not announce any corporate action or transaction involving the registrant. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. It is purely informational commentary on third-party market developments, with no deal terms or corporate changes disclosed. Accordingly, it does not qualify as a special situation for classification purposes.
